# Glass Transitions

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Use GlassEffectContainer and stable glassEffectID values to let nearby glass actions morph into and out of one another. Animate expansion with withAnimation. Use matchedGeometry for nearby actions and materialize when a separate fade is appropriate. This is an inline control transition, not a sheet presentation.

- Before: Actions fade in separately
- After: Nearby glass actions morph together

APIs: `GlassEffectContainer`, `glassEffectID`, `glassEffectTransition`, `withAnimation`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct GlassTransitionDoExample: View {
    var body: some View {
        if #available(iOS 26, macOS 26, *) {
            GlassActionsContent(showsAfter: true)
        } else {
            Text("Requires iOS 26 or macOS 26")
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, macOS 26, *)
struct GlassActionsContent: View {
    let showsAfter: Bool
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @State private var isSaved = false
    @State private var isOffline = false

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 24) {
            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                Button {
                    withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth) {
                        isExpanded.toggle()
                    }
                } label: {
                    Text(isExpanded ? "Close" : "Actions")
                        .font(.body.weight(.medium))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .frame(minWidth: 80, minHeight: 48)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                        .glassEffect(.regular.tint(.blue).interactive(), in: .capsule)
                }
                .glassEffectID("actions", in: namespace)
                .accessibilityLabel(isExpanded ? "Hide collection actions" : "Show collection actions")

                if isExpanded {
                    action(isSaved ? "bookmark.fill" : "bookmark",
                           title: isSaved ? "Unsave collection" : "Save collection",
                           selected: isSaved) { isSaved.toggle() }
                        .glassEffectID("save", in: namespace)
                        .glassEffectTransition(showsAfter ? .matchedGeometry : .materialize)

                    action(isOffline ? "checkmark.circle" : "arrow.down.circle",
                           title: isOffline ? "Remove offline copy" : "Keep offline",
                           selected: isOffline) { isOffline.toggle() }
                        .glassEffectID("offline", in: namespace)
                        .glassEffectTransition(showsAfter ? .matchedGeometry : .materialize)
                }
            }
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        // excerpt:end
    }

    private func action(_ symbol: String, title: String, selected: Bool,
                        perform: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: perform) {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.title3)
                .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                .frame(width: 48, height: 48)
                .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .circle)
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(selected ? "On" : "Off")
    }
}
```
